name: org.istanduk.gov-uk
description: Publishes DITA as a self-contained static website styled with the GOV.UK Design System: sidebar navigation and landing-page layouts, optional Pagefind search whose relevance follows the DITA, generated glossary and index, NHS and official GOV.UK branding modes, a print stylesheet and a whole-publication print document. Output is built to WCAG 2.2 AA and checked in CI.
